definitions.explanation: Having lived or existed for a short time. Used for people and sometimes animals.
Can also describe someone who acts or looks young, or is inexperienced.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{若|わか}いです。
{若|わか}い{時|とき}、たくさん{旅行|りょこう}しました。
examples.english: When I was young, I traveled a lot.

notes: {若|わか}い is primarily used for people (and sometimes animals), unlike {新|あたら}しい which is for things. {若者|わかもの} means 'young person/youth'. {若|わか}く{見|み}える (to look young) is a common compliment.
